page: UpCloud GPU-48xCPU-480GB-2xB200 is a GPU-accelerated server configured with 48 vCPUs and 480.0 GB of system memory. The processing power is delivered by an Intel Xeon 8570 processor utilizing the x86_64 architecture, featuring 48 physical cores with a single thread per core clocked at 2.0 GHz. The server is equipped with two NVIDIA Blackwell B200 GPUs, providing a total of 384 GB of VRAM. It operates on the KVM hypervisor. Notably, this instance does not include local storage, meaning storage must be attached externally.

Benchmark data reveals top-tier performance in several multi-threaded and memory-intensive operations. The server achieved a PassMark CPU score of 88,533.65 and a multi-core stress-ng CPU score of 97,240.84. Memory bandwidth is highly efficient, with read-only large block bandwidth reaching 385.14 GB/sec, placing it in the top tier. For specialized workloads, the system processed 9,458.91 tokens per second for prompt processing using a small 135M LLM model. Multi-threaded bzip3 decompression also registered in the top tier at 706.88 GB/sec.

While the server delivers strong multi-core and GPU capabilities, the CPU allocation is shared, which may introduce resource contention under sustained non-GPU processing. Single-core performance is moderate, with a stress-ng single-core score of 2,168.19 and a PassMark memory score of 2,400.53, both falling into the average category. The lack of local storage requires external network-attached storage, which could affect overall I/O latency. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the high density of GPU VRAM and system memory relative to the shared CPU allocation makes this server type specialized for GPU-bound tasks rather than general-purpose compute.

This server configuration is designed for workloads that heavily leverage GPU acceleration and large memory capacities. Appropriate use cases include large language model inference, machine learning training, data science pipelines, and database operations, as evidenced by its top-tier PassMark database score of 33,288.64.
